detail.title: WK100 Wireless Keyboard with Built-In Touchpad - Gray
detail.overview: The Ant Esports WK100 is a 2-in-1 wireless keyboard with a built-in multi-touch trackpad, eliminating the need for a separate mouse when controlling a smart TV, HTPC or media streaming setup. Dual connectivity via Bluetooth and 2.4GHz gives it a stable, cable-free connection with an operating range of up to 10 metres, and it can switch between two paired devices with a single key press. Twelve multimedia shortcut combinations add quick access to volume, playback and other everyday functions, while the large trackpad supports gestures for pointing, zooming and scrolling. An auto-sleep mode kicks in after 30 minutes of inactivity to save battery, and the slim, durable ABS build makes it compatible with Android, Windows, iOS, Mac OS and Smart TVs alike.
